paite: Huan Ahab sih nung in Israelte tung ah Moabte ahel uhi.
heading: Elijah Leh Kumpipa Ahaziah
english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

paite: Samaria a dantan tungnung vathangkalh tohlet a pan Ahaziah akekhia a, akihihnata hi. Huchi in mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Kuan unla, hiai ka natna ahoihkhe nawn thei hiam Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub va dong un," achi hi.
english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA angel in Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah, "Thou inla, Samaria kumpipa misawlte houpih ding in kuantou inla, akiang uah, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na hong kuan uh?
english: But Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei dia, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va gen in," achi hi. Huchi in Elijah akuanta hi.
english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

paite: Amisawlte akiang ah ahong kik nawn un akiang uah, "Bang achi a ahia na hong kik nawn mawk uh?" achi hi.
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Mi khat hong houpih ding in ahong a, ka kiang uah, pai unla, nou hon sawlpa kumpipa kiang ah kik nawn unla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na sawl? Huchi in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va hilh un ahon chi," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “Yahweh says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hon houpih dia hong, huai thute hong hilhpa mi bangchibang ahia oi?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

paite: Amau adawng ua, "Samul puan a kizem ahi a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak," achi ua; ama'n, "Tishbi mi Elijah ahi ve," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaih sawmnga heutu, aheute sawmnga toh akiang ah asawl hi. Mualvum a tu Elijah kiang ah ahohtou a, ama'n, "Nang, Pathian mi, kumpipa'n hong paisuk in, achi ve," achi hi.
english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

paite: Elijah in adawng a, sepaih sawmnga heutu kiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nangmah leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen," achi hi. Huchi in van a pan mei ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vek uhi.
english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

paite: Akiang ah sepaih sawmnga heutu dang, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang Pathian mi, kumpipa'n, hong paisuk meng in, achi ve," achi hỉ.
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

paite: Elijah in adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nang leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen,” achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mei van a kipan ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vekta uhi.
english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

paite: Sepaih sawmnga dang heutu, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn a, huai sepaih sawmnga dang heutu akuantou a, Elijah ma ah ava khukdin a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa aw, ka hinna leh hiai na sikha mi sawmngate hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen.
english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

paite: Ngai in, van a pan mei ahong kesuk a, sepaih sawmnga heutu nihte aheute sawmnga utoh akangmangta ua; huaiziak in ka hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen," chi in angen hi.
english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in Elijah kiang ah, "Kumsuk pih in, amaute lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, amah toh kumpipa kiang ah akumsukkhawm uhi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ekronte pathian Baal-zebub dong dia mite na sawl, Israel gam a dot ding Pathian a-om louh ziak hia? Huaiziak in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

paite: Huchi in Elijah in agen TOUPA thu bang in asita hi. Tapa aneih louh ziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa, Jehoram kum nih alal kum in, asik in Jehoram alalta hi.
english: So he died according to Yahweh’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

paite: Ahaziah thilhih tanchin dangte Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
